issue.title: Test Gap: Verifying stability of serial console connections to SONiC devices

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the test gap

Existing tests in the console and dut_console modules in sonic-mgmt cover basic console operation but there is no coverage for longer duration stability of console connections.

We need test cases to both read and write large blocks of characters into a serial console connection and ensure that the characters are transmitted successfully.

### Affected Area

Serial Console (console/dut_console modules)

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

Console connections are critical to access a SONiC device during early initialization as well as a last resort mechanism, so it is important for console connections to be stable at all times.

resolution.title: Add serial console stress test
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #21134

This test exercises the console of a SONiC Device by pushing a large block of data into the console as well as generate a large block of of output out of the console to ensure that console remains stable.

This test supports all form factors including fixed and modular. On a modular system (Currently only supports Arista, but can easily be extend to to other systems), it exercises both the supervisor and the linecard console.

This requires extending the related fixtures to create a LinecardConsoleConn helper that can encapsulate the console interaction on a linecard, which requires architecture specific adaptation.
